High-contrast slate and metallic titanium base with vibrant technical safety amber accents. Grid-structured layout, numbered technical chapters, masked line reveal typography, kinetic marquee ribbons, and spotlight product frames.

font_family_pairing.body: Inter / DM Sans (High legibility, balanced neutral line height)

scale_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase leading-[1.05]
scale_rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

visual_enhancers.card_borders: border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-amber-500/50 transition-colors duration-300
visual_enhancers.spotlight_frame: relative overflow-hidden group before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-amber-500/10 before:to-transparent before:opacity-0 group-hover:before:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300

layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous technical spacing. Section padding py-16 lg:py-24, gap-8 to gap-12 between elements.
layout_and_grids.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis momentum smooth scrolling integrated across all routes

framer_motion.hero_line_reveal: Staggered masked height/y-clip reveal for each headline line on mount
framer_motion.scroll_reveal: framer-motion initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} viewport={{ once: true }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
framer_motion.marquee: Slow editorial drift using framer-motion or CSS keyframe ribbon (gap-16, speed: 25s continuous)

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Button hover lift (-translate-y-0.5), active pressure scale-95, card image zoom on hover (scale-105 duration-500)

key_features_to_build.sticky_navbar: Sticky header with logo ('PARISHRAM ENGINEERING'), links (Home, Products, Industries, Manifesto, Contact), Quote Cart Drawer Trigger with Badge Counter, Account Login/Register link, and amber CTA ('Get a Quote').
key_features_to_build.quote_cart_system: Slide-over drawer + dedicated page for B2B quote cart. Users can adjust quantity, add custom material specs/thread requirements, upload technical drawing file note, and submit instant B2B quote enquiry.
key_features_to_build.numbered_manifesto_chapters: Section with 4 chapters: 01. Micro-Precision Metallurgy, 02. Certified Quality Assurance, 03. Custom OEM Manufacturing, 04. Global B2B Supply Network.
key_features_to_build.interactive_spec_calculator: Engineers can select Pipe Size (NPS), Wall Thickness, and Alloy Grade to dynamically compute estimated weight (kg/m) and burst pressure rating, then append calculation to Quote Cart.
key_features_to_build.customer_account: Login / Register modal or route + User Dashboard showing submitted quote history, enquiry status badge (Under Review, Estimate Ready, Approved), and downloadable PDF quotation summary.
key_features_to_build.admin_dashboard: Admin view at /admin to manage product inventory (add/edit products), view & manage customer quote inquiries, update inquiry status, and view analytics summaries.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations and scroll reveals.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Always add data-testid attributes on interactive components (e.g. data-testid='quote-cart-button', data-testid='submit-enquiry-btn', data-testid='product-card-add').
Maintain strict high-contrast legibility for all technical text and mono labels.
Ensure header/navbar background is NEVER fully transparent over scrollable content — use backdrop-blur glassmorphism (e.g., bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md).
Provide realistic pre-seeded products (12-18 products spanning S.S. nipples, barrel nipples, hex nipples, auto bushings, shafts, hydraulic fittings, flanges) with real specs and image URLs.
